title: Comparison submission v0 (and optional maintainer review)
description: One operating-point submission: workload, shared free-parameter record, one or two arms over committed topology files, and results citing content-addressed run ids (docs/submission-format.md). Shape only — the fairness gates (declared-axis exactness, no shared-parameter shadowing, paired results, the delta-zero control), the door's refusal of a self-written review, and the store verification (values must trace to the cited runs exactly) live in essun.evidence.submissions, where the whole submission is available for cross-checking. What the shape DOES freeze: run ids are 64-hex (a result without a run id is not schema-valid), the review block's decision vocabulary, and format_version 0.

format_version.description: The format version this schema and essun.evidence.submissions validate.

submitted.description: Date the submission was posted (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

submitter.description: Public identity of the submitter, as declared in the source thread.

source_url.description: Public, auditable pointer to the submission (issue or PR).

essun_commit.description: Full commit hash of the public tree the cited runs were executed at.

backend.description: Backend id (one of the BACKEND_ID constants of the backend modules; essun.evidence.submissions.BACKENDS is the checked vocabulary).

kind.description: A workload generator kind (the WORKLOAD_KIND constants of essun.workload.*).

parameters.description: The workload's integer shape parameters (plus optional string parameters like model_name); cross-checked against the cited runs' workload file at review.

record.description: Repo-relative committed free-parameter record both arms consume unchanged.

values.description: Parameter id -> value, one record's values fed to every arm; verified against each arm's topology file at the door (equal inputs, read from the files).

label.description: Arm label results reference; unique within the submission.

profile.description: Standard-profile vocabulary id ('none' at v0; the vocabulary widens only when a backend consumes a semantic profile as a run input).

topology.description: Repo-relative committed topology file; the fabric's semantics at L0 enter through this file's honesty headers.

parameters.description: Arm-local free-parameter binds; may not shadow a shared_parameters id.

differs_on.description: The axes the arms differ on — and the ONLY fields they may differ on; the validator recomputes the actual difference set and requires exact equality.

control.description: true declares the arms numerically identical (the delta-zero honesty anchor); paired values must then be exactly equal.

arm.description: Which arm's result this row is; must name a declared label.

metric.description: The field of the observation holding the value (e.g. completion_time_ns_max).

value.description: The reported value, exact (integer or exact numeric string); at review it must equal the cited runs' stored observation exactly.

run_ids.description: The stored run ids that produced this value. Required: a result without a run id is an opinion.

decision.description: The maintainer's decision; 'published' requires every cited run id in verified_run_ids.

basis.description: What was re-executed and checked (commands, commits, what matched).

verified_run_ids.description: Run ids re-executed locally that regenerated byte-for-byte.

review.description: Maintainer-appended only; a review block in a door submission is refused.
